title: 1986 AMC 8 Problem 15
statement: Sale prices at the Ajax Outlet Store are \(50\%\) below original prices. On Saturdays an additional discount of \(20\%\) off the sale price is given. What is the Saturday price of a coat whose original price is \(\$180?\)

solutions.text:
The sale price is \(50\%\) of \(\$180,\) or \(\$90.\) The Saturday price takes another \(20\%\) off, leaving \(80\%\) of \(\$90,\) which is \(\$72.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B .
hints: A \(50\%\) discount leaves half the original price
Then take \(80\%\) of that sale price to apply the extra \(20\%\) off
